title: Would be great if they would include all the right knifes
text:
Would be great if they would include all the right knifes. This is a very nice knife block with a great set of knives. It comes really with all the knives you want and need for your kitchen needs, plus scissors and a knife sharpener. The block looks great and I really like everything about it to be honest.

However, if you send me a set like this, please make sure you check that everything that is supposed to be in it is! I am missing a paring knife but instead got 2 Japanese style knifes. Well needless to say the Japanese style knife does not fit where the paring knife is supposed to go so that now goes into the drawer, no big deal but now I have an empty spot in the block and am missing a paring knife. Not happy about that at all! And for that I am deducting stars.
